verdict.rationale: The search docs give one approximate latency figure: direct vector search runs at about 0.5 seconds and is recommended when speed is critical. Nothing else backs this up: there are no percentiles, no benchmark method and no independent measurements, and the agentic search mode has no latency figure at all. missing for 10: p50/p95/p99 latency numbers, published benchmark methodology or load conditions, latency targets for agentic search and other modes, independent or hands-on latency measurements.
